actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it is &reference[grappled] (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is &reference[restrained], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't [[lookup @item.name]] another target.

actions.name: heated body
actions.desc: A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes [[/damage average]] damage.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.VBzqw2rOUvTuNOPI.Item.Qcgc4zckQ7c1Ky8t]{Bite} attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is &reference[grappling]. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage activity=uTz7h3Og3Q3YACla average]] damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.
